lines.t: Daniel, do you have a minute? The Henderson order still hasn't shipped, and they've called twice this morning.
I know. The warehouse says two of the items are on back order until the eighth.
That's almost two weeks out. Can we send what we have now and ship the rest later?
We could, but they'd be charged for two deliveries. Let me call their purchasing manager and see if they'd rather wait.
Good idea. If they do agree to wait, please put it in writing so we have a record.

questions.q: What is the problem?
choices: An order has not been sent out.
questions.note: 主旨題。整段都在講 Henderson 的訂單還沒出貨。(C) 費用是後面才提到的枝節，不是問題本身。

questions.q: What does the man say he will do?
questions.note: 細節題。男子說 Let me call their purchasing manager —— 選項用 contact 換掉 call，這是正解常見的改寫方式。

questions.q: What does the woman ask the man to do?
questions.note: 最後一句 put it in writing。★ Part 3 的第三題通常對應對話的最後幾句，聽到尾聲要特別集中。

lines.t: Good morning. I have a reservation under Okafor, but I know I'm quite early. Is there any chance the room is ready?
Let me check. I'm afraid housekeeping is still on that floor. Check-in is normally at three.
That's a problem. I have a client meeting at one and I was hoping to change first.
There's a fitness centre on the second floor with changing rooms and showers. You're welcome to use those, and we'll store your luggage at the desk.
That would work perfectly. Thank you.

questions.q: Where most likely are the speakers?
questions.note: 地點題。reservation、check-in、housekeeping 三個詞合起來只指向飯店。(C) 健身中心只是飯店裡的設施，是陷阱。

questions.q: Why is the man concerned?
choices: He needs to change before an appointment.
questions.note: 細節題。男子說 I have a client meeting at one and I was hoping to change first。

questions.q: What does the woman offer?
questions.note: ★ 提議題。Part 3 幾乎每組都有一題問「某人提議什麼」，聽到 You're welcome to... 就是答案所在。

lines.t: We've narrowed the applicants down to four. I'd like to get the interviews done before the end of next week.
That's tight. I'm at the Osaka office Monday and Tuesday, so that leaves Wednesday through Friday.
Three days for four people is fine. Would you mind if we did the first one by video while you're away?
Not at all, as long as someone sends me the candidate's portfolio beforehand. I'd rather not read it on my phone at the airport.
I'll email everything tonight so you have it before you fly out.

questions.q: What are the speakers mainly discussing?
questions.note: 主旨題。(B) 大阪出差只是限制條件，不是主題——把限制條件誤當主題是主旨題最常見的錯法。

questions.q: Why is the man unavailable early in the week?
choices: He will be at another office.
questions.note: 細節題。I'm at the Osaka office Monday and Tuesday。

questions.q: What does the man request?
questions.note: ★ 男子答應時附了條件：as long as someone sends me the candidate's portfolio beforehand。條件句常常就是答案。

items.scene: 電話語音留言・維修改期

lines.t: Hello, this is Ray Delgado from Brightline Facilities calling for Ms. Chen. I'm following up about the air-conditioning service we scheduled for Thursday morning.
Unfortunately, the replacement compressor we ordered won't reach our depot until Thursday afternoon, so our technician wouldn't be able to complete the work in one visit.
Rather than have him come twice, I'd like to move the appointment to Friday at nine. He'd then have everything he needs on site.
If Friday doesn't suit you, please call me back on extension four-one-two before end of day tomorrow and we'll find another slot. Otherwise I'll assume Friday is fine. Thank you.

questions.q: What is the purpose of the message?
questions.note: 目的題。★ Part 4 的第一題幾乎都問目的，而答案幾乎都在**前兩句**——開頭沒聽到就很難補回來。

questions.q: Why does the speaker suggest a change?
questions.note: 細節題。the replacement compressor won't reach our depot until Thursday afternoon。part 是 compressor 的上位詞改寫。

questions.q: What does the speaker ask the listener to do if the new time is inconvenient?
questions.note: ★ 條件式指示：please call me back... before end of day tomorrow。注意題目問的是「不方便時」該做什麼。

lines.t: Attention shoppers. Thank you for visiting Marlow's Home and Garden this afternoon.

Please note that beginning this Monday, our second-floor lighting department will close for four weeks of renovation. During that time, lighting products will be available in the temporary section at the rear of the ground floor.
Customers who have already placed special orders will be contacted by phone, so there is no need to check with the service desk.
And as a thank-you for your patience, anyone spending over fifty dollars this weekend will receive a ten-dollar voucher toward their next visit.

questions.q: Where is the announcement being made?
questions.note: 地點題。Marlow's Home and Garden ＋ shoppers ＋ service desk。(A) 拿 lighting 當陷阱。

questions.q: What will happen on Monday?
questions.note: 細節題。★ 聽到日期或星期就要提高警覺，Part 4 很愛拿時間點出題。

questions.q: What are customers with special orders told?
choices: They should visit the service desk.
questions.note: ★ 陷阱在 there is no need to check with the service desk —— (C) 正好是廣播明講「不需要做」的事。否定敘述常被改寫成錯誤選項。

lines.t: Good evening. I booked a table for eight under Whitfield, but the person at the door says there's nothing under that name.
Let me have a look. I do see a Whitfield, but it's for eight o'clock, not for eight people.
Oh no. Whoever took the call must have misheard me. There are eight of us and everyone's already parked.
Don't worry, we can push two tables together by the window. It'll take about ten minutes to set up.
Ten minutes is nothing. We were expecting to be turned away.

questions.q: What is the problem?
questions.note: 問題題。★ 陷阱在 eight 這個字被用了兩次意思不同：八點 vs 八個人。數字重複出現時要聽清楚它修飾什麼。

questions.q: What does the man offer to do?
questions.note: 提議題。push two tables together 被改寫成 combine two tables —— 正解幾乎都會換字。

questions.q: What does the woman mean when she says, "Ten minutes is nothing"?
choices: She thinks the wait is too long.
questions.note: ★ 意圖題（新制特色）。字面是「十分鐘不算什麼」，實際在表達願意等。這類題不能只翻譯字面，要看前後文——她下一句說本來以為會被趕走。

lines.t: Hi, I put in a ticket this morning about my laptop shutting itself down. Has anyone had a chance to look at it?
I saw it come through. It's probably the battery — we've had four of the same model do that this month.
Four? That's reassuring. Can it be swapped today? I'm presenting to the board on Thursday.
We keep spares for that model, so yes. Bring it down after lunch and I'll do it while you wait.
Perfect. I'll come by around one.

questions.q: Why is the man contacting the woman?
choices: To follow up on a repair request.
questions.note: 目的題。put in a ticket ＝ 報修單。(A) 週四的簡報只是他急的理由，不是他找對方的目的。

questions.q: What does the woman suggest is causing the problem?
questions.note: 細節題。It's probably the battery。

questions.q: What does the man mean when he says, "Four? That's reassuring"?
choices: He is worried about the other laptops.
He thinks four is too few.
He is relieved the fault is a known one.
questions.note: ★ 意圖題。表面在講數字，實際是「原來是常見故障，那就好辦」。★ 注意這裡不是反話——他接著就問能不能今天換，語氣是放心的。

lines.t: I've gone through the three quotes for the packaging contract. Kesler came in lowest, but their lead time is six weeks.
Six weeks won't work for the spring launch. What about the second one?
Ardmore is about twelve percent higher, but they can deliver in three weeks and they're twenty minutes from the plant.
Being close matters more than people think. If something's wrong with a batch, we can drive over the same day.
That's what I thought too. I'll draft a recommendation for Ardmore and send it round before Friday.

questions.q: What are the speakers discussing?
questions.note: 主旨題。(B) 春季上市只是限制條件；(D) 距離工廠很近是選擇理由，不是要搬廠。

questions.q: What is the main drawback of the lowest quote?
choices: It takes too long to deliver.
The supplier is too far away.
questions.note: 細節題。Kesler 最便宜但 lead time is six weeks。(D) 距離遠是拿另一家的優點反過來設的陷阱。

questions.q: What will the woman do next?
questions.note: ★ 下一步題。答案幾乎永遠在最後一兩句：I'll draft a recommendation。

lines.t: I'd like to sign up for the data analysis course, but the sign-up sheet says it's full.
It filled up in two days. We're running a second session in October if you can wait.
My performance review is in September, and I listed that course as one of my goals.
In that case, let me add you to the waiting list and note the reason. People do drop out — usually two or three each time.
I'd appreciate that. Should I email you the details, or is the list already open?

questions.q: What does the man want to do?
questions.note: 目的題。sign up for ＝ enrol in，換字改寫。

questions.q: Why does the man mention his performance review?
choices: To explain why the timing matters.
questions.note: ★ 「為什麼提到某件事」是高頻題型，考的是**功能**不是內容。他提考核是為了說明為何不能等到十月。

questions.q: What does the woman say about the waiting list?
questions.note: 細節題。People do drop out — usually two or three each time，改寫成 spots often open up。

items.scene: 辦公室搬遷・座位安排

lines.t: The movers arrive Saturday morning. Have you decided where the design team is going?
I was going to put them on the north side, but they've asked to be near the print room.
That's the noisiest corner of the floor. Are they sure?
They said they'd rather have the noise than walk the length of the building twenty times a day.
Fair enough. Just make sure it's in writing so nobody complains about it in three months.

questions.q: What is scheduled for Saturday?
questions.note: 細節題。The movers arrive Saturday morning。★ 聽到星期就要抓，Part 3 很愛考。

questions.q: Why does the design team want the location near the print room?
choices: To avoid walking a long distance.
questions.note: 細節題。(A) 正好相反——那裡是最吵的角落，是拿對話裡明講的反面設陷阱。

questions.q: What does the woman recommend?
questions.note: ★ 建議題，答案在最後一句 make sure it's in writing。documenting 是 in writing 的換字。

lines.t: Excuse me, the board says my flight to Denver is delayed, but it doesn't give a new time.
There's weather moving through Denver. The aircraft is still on the ground in Phoenix, so we're looking at three hours at least.
Three hours. Is there anything going through Salt Lake City instead?
There is, but it leaves in forty minutes and you'd have to check in again at the far end of the terminal.
I only have a carry-on. Put me on it and I'll run.

questions.q: Where does this conversation most likely take place?
questions.note: 地點題。the board、terminal、check in again 三個線索。(B) 旅行社不會有航班顯示板與航廈。

questions.q: What is causing the delay?
questions.note: 細節題。There's weather moving through Denver。

questions.q: What does the man decide to do?
questions.note: ★ 決定題。Put me on it ＝ 幫我劃那班。經 Salt Lake City 轉機就是 a different route。

lines.t: I ordered two office chairs on the fourteenth and only one arrived. The invoice shows both.
I'm sorry about that. Let me check the shipment... it looks like the second chair went out from a different warehouse.
So it's on its way? Nobody told me it would be split.
It should reach you Wednesday. I'll email you the tracking number now, and I'll add a note so you're not charged for the second delivery.
Thank you. As long as it's here before the new staff start on Monday, we're fine.

questions.q: Why is the woman calling?
choices: Part of her order is missing.
She wants to cancel an order.
questions.note: 目的題。only one arrived。(C) 費用是男子後面主動提的，不是她打來的原因。

questions.q: What does the man say he will do?
questions.note: 細節題。I'll email you the tracking number now。(B) 是陷阱——第二張椅子不是補寄，本來就在路上。

questions.q: What does the woman imply about Monday?
questions.note: ★ 推論題。before the new staff start on Monday。(B) 送達是週三不是週一，把兩個日期混在一起是常見失分點。

lines.t: Welcome to the Ridgeway bottling facility. My name is Anna and I'll be taking you through the plant this morning.
Before we go in, a few points about safety. Everyone must wear the vest and glasses you were given at reception, and please stay behind the yellow line at all times.
The tour runs about fifty minutes. We'll start at the filling line, move through quality control, and finish in the warehouse.
Photography is permitted everywhere except quality control, where the equipment is still under a supplier agreement. I'll remind you when we get there.

questions.q: Who most likely is the speaker?
choices: A tour guide at a factory.
questions.note: 身分題。I'll be taking you through the plant ＝ 帶導覽。(C) 廠長不會這樣自我介紹。

questions.q: What are listeners required to do?
questions.note: 細節題。must wear the vest and glasses，改寫成 protective equipment。

questions.q: Where are listeners not allowed to take photographs?
questions.note: ★ 例外題。everywhere except quality control —— 聽到 except 就要立刻標記，那通常就是題目要問的。

items.scene: 機場廣播・登機門更改

lines.t: Attention passengers on Coastal Air flight two-one-four to Halifax. This is a gate change announcement.
Your flight will now depart from gate C-nineteen rather than B-seven. C-nineteen is in the adjoining concourse, reachable by the shuttle train on the lower level.
Because of the distance, boarding has been pushed back by twenty minutes. Passengers requiring assistance should speak to an agent at the B-seven desk before moving.
We apologise for the inconvenience and thank you for your patience.

questions.q: What is the announcement mainly about?
questions.note: 主旨題。★ 第二句就明講 This is a gate change announcement —— Part 4 開頭兩句是最貴的資訊。

questions.q: How can passengers reach the new gate?
choices: By taking a lift to the roof.
questions.note: 細節題。reachable by the shuttle train on the lower level。

questions.q: What should passengers who need help do?
choices: Speak to an agent before leaving.
questions.note: ★ 指示題。before moving 是關鍵——要先找地勤再過去，不是到了新登機門再說。

items.scene: 會議開場・新請假制度

lines.t: Thanks for coming in early, everyone. I'll keep this short because I know several of you have client calls at nine.
From the first of next month, all leave requests move to the new online system. Paper forms will no longer be accepted, even for a single day.
The change is mainly for the managers, who currently have to chase signatures across three floors. Requests will now go straight to your supervisor's queue.
Training is optional, but I'd strongly suggest the twenty-minute session on Thursday. Those who skipped the expenses training last year are still emailing me every week.

questions.q: What is the purpose of the talk?
choices: To introduce a new leave request system.
To announce a change in working hours.
questions.note: 目的題。(D) 九點的客戶電話只是她長話短說的理由。

questions.q: According to the speaker, who benefits most from the change?
questions.note: 細節題。mainly for the managers, who currently have to chase signatures。

questions.q: What does the speaker imply about the training session?
choices: Attending it will save trouble later.
It is required for all staff.
questions.note: ★ 意圖題。她說訓練是自由參加，卻舉去年沒去上課的人「到現在每週都在寄信問我」——這是在暗示不去會後悔。(D) 錯在她明說 optional。

items.scene: 廣播廣告・健身房開幕

lines.t: Tired of driving across town just to get on a treadmill? Corbin Fitness opens its third location this Saturday, right on Maple Street.
The new club has everything our members already love — the pool, the climbing wall, and classes running from five in the morning until ten at night.
Join during opening week and we'll waive the registration fee, normally sixty dollars. Existing members can use the new location at no extra cost.
Visit corbinfitness dot com to book a free trial session. No card details required.

questions.q: What is being advertised?
choices: A new branch of a fitness club.
questions.note: 主旨題。opens its third location ＝ 新分店。(D) 器材只是設施描述。

questions.q: What is offered during the opening week?
questions.note: 細節題。waive the registration fee。★ waive（免除）這個字在廣告型 Part 4 幾乎必考。

questions.q: What does the speaker say about existing members?
choices: They may use the new site for free.
questions.note: 細節題。at no extra cost ＝ for free。

items.scene: 電話語音選單・營業時間

lines.t: Thank you for calling Larkin Dental. Our office is currently closed.
We are open Monday through Thursday from eight to five, and on Friday from eight until noon. We are closed on weekends and public holidays.
If this is a dental emergency, please hang up and call our on-call line at five-five-five, zero-one-nine-two. That line is answered around the clock.
To request an appointment, leave your name, number, and preferred day after the tone, and a member of our team will return your call on the next working day.

questions.q: When does the office close on Fridays?
questions.note: ★ 細節題，陷阱在同一句話裡有兩組時間。Friday from eight until noon —— 五點是週一到週四的。

questions.q: What should a caller with an emergency do?
choices: Wait for the next working day.
questions.note: 細節題。hang up and call our on-call line。(C) 留言是預約用的，不是急診用的。

questions.q: When will the office return an appointment call?
questions.note: ★ 最後一句。(A) 直接與前面「週末不營業」矛盾——Part 4 常在不同段落埋互相牴觸的線索。

lines.t: I'm looking for the original floor plans for the Bellamy building. The system says they're held here.
Anything before two thousand is still on paper in the basement. Do you have the project number?
I have the address but not the number. Is that enough to find them?
It'll take longer, but yes. I can pull them by tomorrow afternoon. They can't leave the building, though — you'd have to scan what you need here.
That's fine. I only need the second floor.

questions.q: What does the man want to obtain?
questions.note: 目的題。floor plans ＝ building plans。

questions.q: What does the woman ask for?
questions.note: 細節題。Do you have the project number?

questions.q: What restriction does the woman mention?
questions.note: ★ 限制題。They can't leave the building —— 聽到 though、however、but 之後常接限制條件，那通常就是考點。

lines.t: I'd like to add a second signatory to our company account. Our new finance manager starts Monday.
Certainly. We'll need her identification and a board resolution authorising the change.
A board resolution? Our last bank just needed a form.
Requirements changed last year for business accounts. I can email you a template — most companies get it signed the same week.
Send it over and I'll get it on the agenda for Wednesday.

questions.q: What does the woman want to do?
questions.note: 目的題。add a second signatory ＝ 增加有權簽章的人。

questions.q: Why is the woman surprised?
choices: Her manager has not started yet.
The fee is higher than expected.
A different bank had simpler requirements.
questions.note: ★ 情緒／反應題。Our last bank just needed a form 就是驚訝的來源。

questions.q: What does the man offer to send?
questions.note: 細節題。I can email you a template。

lines.t: This is the unit I mentioned. Four hundred square metres, and the lease starts in November.
It's brighter than the last one. But I count only twelve parking spaces for a team of thirty.
There's a public garage across the road. Many tenants here buy monthly passes for their staff.
That's an extra cost we hadn't budgeted. Can the landlord include a few more spaces in the lease?
I can ask. It would probably mean a slightly higher rent, but it's worth putting the question.

questions.q: What are the speakers looking at?
questions.note: 地點題。the lease starts in November ＝ 租約。(D) 是 for sale，與 lease 矛盾。

questions.q: What concern does the woman raise?
questions.note: 細節題。(C) 正好相反——她說 It's brighter than the last one。★ 拿對話裡明講的反面設陷阱，是 Part 3 最常見的手法。

questions.q: What does the man say he will do?
choices: Ask the landlord about the request.
questions.note: 下一步題。I can ask。

lines.t: I've reviewed the catalogue proof. The colours are good, but page eleven still shows last season's prices.
That's the file we received on the fourth. Did someone send an updated version after that?
Our marketing team sent one on the seventh. It may have gone to the wrong address.
Let's not chase it. Send it straight to me now and I'll swap that page. We're not on press until Thursday.
Sending it now. And could you send a fresh proof of just that page before you print?

questions.q: What problem does the woman identify?
choices: Outdated pricing appears in the proof.
questions.note: 問題題。(C) 相反——她說顏色沒問題。

questions.q: What does the man mean when he says, "Let's not chase it"?
choices: He prefers to fix the issue directly.
He will investigate the error later.
He wants to cancel the job.
He thinks the file is unimportant.
questions.note: ★ 意圖題。不去追究檔案跑到哪，直接叫對方重寄。重點是「省時間」，不是「不在乎」。

questions.q: What does the woman request?
choices: A new proof of one page.
questions.note: 要求題，答案在最後一句。★ 注意是「只有那一頁」的新校樣，不是整份。

lines.t: I have an appointment with Dr. Reyes on Tuesday at four, but I've been asked to cover a shift.
Let me see what else she has. There's Thursday at eight-thirty in the morning, or the following Monday at two.
Thursday morning would mean going in before work. Actually, that suits me better than the afternoon.
I'll move you to Thursday. Please arrive ten minutes early — the forms have changed since your last visit.
Understood. Do I need to bring anything else?

questions.q: Why does the man want to change his appointment?
questions.note: 原因題。I've been asked to cover a shift ＝ 要代班。

questions.q: When will the man now see the doctor?
questions.note: ★ 三個時間選項全部在對話裡出現過，只有一個是他最後選的。這種題一定要聽到最後才作答。

questions.q: What is the man asked to do?
questions.note: 指示題。arrive ten minutes early。

lines.t: Before we finish, where are we on the Vasquez rollout? We promised them a date this week.
Development is done. We finished testing on Friday and there's nothing outstanding on my side.
Training is the hold-up. I still have two of their five sites unscheduled, and one of them is on an island.
Can the island site be done remotely?
It could, but their internet has been unreliable. I'd rather go in person than have it fail halfway.
If it helps, I can join that session by phone as backup.

questions.q: What is delaying the project?
choices: Training has not been scheduled everywhere.
questions.note: 問題題。(C)(B) 都被第二位說話者明確排除：Development is done、nothing outstanding。★ 三人對話要分清楚哪句話是誰說的。

questions.q: Why does the third speaker prefer to travel?
choices: It is cheaper than remote training.
questions.note: 原因題。their internet has been unreliable。

questions.q: What does the second speaker offer?
choices: To provide backup support by phone.
questions.note: ★ 提議題。I can join that session by phone as backup。(B) 去島上的是第三位，不是他——三人對話最愛考「張冠李戴」。

lines.t: We've had a look at your van. The brakes are fine, but the timing belt is due and one tyre is below the legal tread.
How much are we talking about altogether?
Around six hundred with the tyre. The belt is the bigger part of that, but if it goes it can damage the engine.
The van's on the road every day, so I can't risk that. Can you do it today?
If you leave it with us, yes. We close at six.

questions.q: What does the woman say about the brakes?
questions.note: ★ 細節題，考的是「沒問題」的那一項。The brakes are fine —— 選項刻意把三個部位混在一起，要聽清楚哪個對應哪個。

questions.q: Why does the man agree to the repair?
choices: The price is lower than expected.
He depends on the vehicle daily.
questions.note: 原因題。The van's on the road every day, so I can't risk that。

questions.q: What does the woman require?
choices: That the vehicle be left at the garage.
questions.note: 條件題。If you leave it with us, yes —— 條件句常常就是答案。

lines.t: The organisers have given us stand forty-two. It's the same size as last year but near the back.
The back isn't necessarily bad. Last year the corner stands got more traffic than the ones by the entrance.
That matches what I saw. People walk past the entrance stands on their way in and stop later.
Then I won't ask to move. What I would like is a second screen, so two demonstrations can run at once.
The rental list is on the portal. I'll book one this afternoon before they run out.

questions.q: What are the speakers mainly discussing?
choices: Arrangements for a trade show stand.
questions.note: 主旨題。(B) 示範只是他們想加螢幕的用途。

questions.q: What do the second and third speakers agree about?
choices: Rear stands can attract more visitors.
The entrance is the best position.
questions.note: ★ 三人對話特有的「兩人共識」題。(D) 正好是他們一起否定的說法。

questions.q: What will the second speaker do?
questions.note: 下一步題。I'll book one this afternoon。

lines.t: I'm calling about claim number four-four-one-nine. It's been three weeks and I haven't heard anything.
Let me pull it up... I see the assessor's report came in, but we're waiting on the repair invoice from the workshop.
The workshop told me they sent it a fortnight ago.
It's possible it went to the old claims address. I'll call them myself today and confirm. Once we have it, payment usually takes four working days.
Please do. And could you note my mobile on the file? I'm rarely at the office number.

questions.q: Why is the man calling?
choices: To ask about the status of a claim.
questions.note: 目的題。I haven't heard anything ＝ 問進度。

questions.q: What is the claim waiting for?
questions.note: ★ 細節題。(D) 是**已經收到**的那一份——把「已完成」和「還在等」對調是高頻陷阱。

questions.q: What does the man ask the woman to do?
questions.note: 要求題，在最後一句：could you note my mobile on the file。

lines.t: Welcome aboard. Your laptop is set up, but IT couldn't create your email until your contract was countersigned.
I signed it last Thursday. Should I chase someone?
No, it came back yesterday. Your account should be live by this afternoon. In the meantime, spend the morning on the onboarding modules.
How long do those take? I was hoping to sit in on the client call at eleven.
Go to the call — that'll teach you more than the modules will. You can do those any time this week.

questions.q: Who most likely is the woman?
choices: The man's new colleague or manager.
questions.note: 身分題。Welcome aboard ＋ 交代第一天要做什麼。

questions.q: Why is the man's email account not ready?
choices: He has not chosen a password.
questions.note: 原因題。until your contract was countersigned，昨天才回來。

questions.q: What does the woman mean when she says, "Go to the call"?
choices: She thinks the meeting is more valuable.
She wants him out of the office.
questions.note: ★ 意圖題。她補了一句 that'll teach you more than the modules will，說明她認為會議比線上課程有價值。(B) 錯在她沒說是強制的。

lines.t: You are now standing in the east wing, in front of the museum's oldest holding — a merchant's ledger from fourteen ninety-two.
What makes the ledger remarkable is not its age but its detail. It records the price of every item the merchant traded, giving historians a rare picture of daily life.
The case is kept dark because the ink fades under strong light. Please do not use flash photography anywhere in this room.
When you are ready, continue to your left for the textiles gallery, or press three to hear more about how the ledger was recovered.

questions.q: What is the speaker describing?
questions.note: 主旨題。ledger ＝ 帳冊。就算不認得這個字，from fourteen ninety-two 與 records the price 也指向文件。

questions.q: According to the speaker, why is the item significant?
choices: It is the oldest object ever found.
It is made from rare material.
It was written by a famous historian.
It records everyday transactions in detail.
questions.note: ★ 細節題。not its age but its detail —— not A but B 的句型，答案永遠在 but 後面。

questions.q: What are listeners asked not to do?
questions.note: 禁止題。do not use flash photography。

lines.t: And now your drive-time update. Heavy rain overnight has left standing water on the coastal road between Marsden and Fairview.
Crews are pumping the worst section clear, but one lane remains closed and delays of around twenty-five minutes are being reported.
If you are heading north, the inland route through Weatherby is longer in distance but currently running normally.
The rain is expected to ease by mid-morning, with clearer conditions for the evening commute.

questions.q: What is causing the delays?
questions.note: 原因題。standing water ＝ 積水。

questions.q: What does the speaker recommend for drivers heading north?
questions.note: ★ 建議題。longer in distance but currently running normally —— 雖然遠但是通的。(D) 是天氣預報，不是給北上駕駛的建議。

questions.q: What does the speaker say about the evening?
questions.note: 預測題。clearer conditions for the evening commute。

lines.t: Before we move on to dessert, I'd like to take a moment for this year's service award.
The recipient joined us as a temporary warehouse assistant eleven years ago and now runs our entire distribution network across three countries.
What the committee kept coming back to was not the promotions, but the number of colleagues who named him as the person who trained them.
Please join me in congratulating Tomas Bergeron. Tomas, come up and say a few words — and yes, we have timed you.

questions.q: Where is the talk most likely taking place?
questions.note: 地點題。before we move on to dessert ＝ 正在用餐。

questions.q: Why was the award recipient chosen?
choices: He has the longest service record.
He trained many of his colleagues.
He was promoted the most times.
questions.note: ★ not the promotions, but the number of colleagues who named him —— 又是 not A but B。(C) 正是被否定的那個。

questions.q: What does the speaker imply when she says, "we have timed you"?
questions.note: ★ 意圖題，帶玩笑語氣。「我們計時了」＝ 請講短一點。

lines.t: This is an important safety notice from Halden Appliances regarding our model T-forty kettle.
A small number of units manufactured between March and May may have a faulty base connector, which can cause the kettle to overheat.
The affected batch codes are printed underneath the unit and listed on our website. If your code appears, stop using the kettle immediately.
Return it to any stockist for a full refund or a free replacement. You do not need a receipt, but please do not attempt to repair the unit yourself.

questions.q: What is the purpose of the announcement?
choices: To warn customers about a defective product.
questions.note: 目的題。safety notice ＋ faulty connector。

questions.q: How can customers check whether their kettle is affected?
choices: By returning it to the factory.
By looking at the batch code on the base.
questions.note: 細節題。batch codes are printed underneath the unit。

questions.q: What are customers told they do NOT need?
questions.note: ★ 否定題。You do not need a receipt —— 題目問「不需要什麼」，聽到 do not need 要立刻記下。

lines.t: Attention passengers waiting on platform four for the ten-fifteen service to Crestwood.
Because of a signalling fault south of Danforth, this service is delayed by approximately forty minutes. It will now depart at around ten fifty-five.
Passengers travelling only as far as Danforth may wish to take the eleven o'clock bus from outside the main entrance, which will arrive sooner.
Refreshment vouchers are available from the ticket office for anyone holding a ticket for the delayed service.

questions.q: What has caused the delay?
questions.note: 原因題。a signalling fault south of Danforth。

questions.q: What alternative is suggested for some passengers?
questions.note: ★ 注意限定條件：只有 travelling only as far as Danforth 的人適用，不是所有人。

questions.q: What is available at the ticket office?
questions.note: 細節題。Refreshment vouchers。(B) 沒提到退費，是想當然耳的陷阱。

lines.t: Good morning, and welcome to the customer response workshop. I'm Elias, and I've been running these for about six years.
We'll spend the first hour on written replies and the second on difficult phone calls. There's a break at half past ten.
I should say up front that this is not a lecture. You'll be working in pairs on real complaints from our own inbox, with the names removed.
If you'd rather not read your work aloud, that's completely fine — just let me know when we get to that part.

questions.q: What is the workshop about?
questions.note: 主旨題。customer response workshop。

questions.q: What will participants do during the session?
choices: Work in pairs on real cases.
questions.note: ★ this is not a lecture 是關鍵——說話者刻意否定「聽講」的形式。(A)(C) 都是被排除的被動形式。

questions.q: What does the speaker say participants may choose to avoid?
questions.note: 細節題。If you'd rather not read your work aloud, that's completely fine。

lines.t: After thirty-two years on Harbour Street, Penrose Books will be closing its doors at the end of next month.
From this Friday, everything in the shop is reduced — forty percent off all books, and sixty percent off maps, prints and stationery.
Gift cards must be used before the final day. After that we will not be able to honour them, so please do bring them in.
We're open the usual hours, and we'd love to see the faces we've served over the years one last time.

questions.q: What is the main purpose of the advertisement?
questions.note: 目的題。closing its doors ＋ everything reduced。

questions.q: Which items have the largest discount?
questions.note: ★ 比較題。書 40%、地圖文具 60% —— 兩個百分比同時出現時，一定會考哪個比較多。

questions.q: What are listeners urged to do with gift cards?
choices: Use them before the shop closes.
questions.note: ★ must be used before the final day，而且明說之後無法兌現。(C)(B) 都與「無法兌現」矛盾。

lines.t: Hello, this message is for Priya Raman. My name is Colin Voss, calling from Aldermoor Logistics about your application for the operations coordinator role.
We'd like to invite you to an interview. It would be with two people — myself and the warehouse director — and would last around forty-five minutes.
We can offer Tuesday morning or Wednesday afternoon of next week. If neither works, we do have some flexibility the following week.
Please reply to the email I've just sent rather than calling back, as I'm travelling and won't pick up. Thank you, and we look forward to meeting you.

questions.q: Why is the speaker calling?
questions.note: ★ 目的題。invite you to an interview —— (B) 是還沒發生的下一步，別跳太快。

questions.q: What does the speaker say about the interview?
questions.note: 細節題。It would be with two people。(A) 拿 two 這個數字誤導到時間長度。

questions.q: How does the speaker want the listener to respond?
questions.note: ★ reply to the email rather than calling back —— rather than 之後的是被排除的做法，正好是最誘人的錯誤選項。

lines.t: Have you decided which afternoon session you're going to, Kenji? I signed up for the one at three o'clock.
I was going to do that one with you, actually, but my manager asked me to take the leadership session instead.
Oh, that's the earlier slot. You'll have to skip the group lunch, then. It doesn't finish until one thirty.
I'll grab something quick beforehand. Could you save me a seat at the reception tonight?
Of course. It starts at six in the lobby.

questions.q: Why did the man change his plans?
choices: He had a conflict with a client.
His manager gave him a different assignment.
questions.note: 細節題。my manager asked me to take the leadership session instead。

questions.q: Look at the graphic. Which room will the man go to?
questions.note:
圖表題。★ 男子從頭到尾沒說過任何房號 —— 他只說了 leadership，房號要自己從表上查。
★ 陷阱：唯一被念出來的時間是 three o'clock，那是女子的場次。只抓數字不查表就會中招。
★ 通則：聽到的是「一欄」，要答的是「另一欄」。

questions.q: What does the woman agree to do?
choices: Save a seat for the man.
questions.note: 最後兩句。Part 3 第三題通常落在對話結尾。

lines.t: Hi, I'd like to have some training booklets printed. I originally planned on eighty copies.
Sure, we can handle that. Has the number changed?
It has. The operations department is joining the session now, so I'll need a hundred and twenty.
Good news, actually. That moves you into a better rate. When do you need them by?
Thursday morning if possible. The workshop starts at nine.
We can have them ready Wednesday afternoon. I'll email you a confirmation once your file uploads.

questions.q: What does the woman want to have printed?
questions.note: 開頭第一句。Part 3 第一題常是「主旨／來意」，答案幾乎都在前兩句。

questions.q: Look at the graphic. How much will the woman pay per copy?
questions.note:
圖表題。★ 對話裡沒有出現任何金額，只出現數量。
★ 陷阱：先講的 eighty 落在 1–99 那列（$0.40），但她隨即改成 a hundred and twenty。
★ 圖表題很愛「先講一個數字再改掉」，要聽到最後一個確定的數字才動手查表。

questions.q: What does the man say he will do?
questions.note: 最後一句 I'll email you a confirmation。

lines.t: Sorry to bother you. I'm supposed to meet the design team at ten, but I can't find the right room.
They moved last week. It's not the big conference room anymore. Go down the main hallway and it's the office directly across from the break room.
Directly across from the break room. Is that anywhere near the copier?
Right next to it. And if you need to print the agenda, the copier was finally repaired yesterday.
That's a relief. I'll head over now, thanks.

questions.q: Why does the woman speak to the man?
choices: She is late for a flight.
She wants to borrow a laptop.
questions.note: 來意題。I can't find the right room。

questions.q: Look at the graphic. Where will the woman go?
questions.note:
圖表題。★ 房間名稱一次都沒被念出來，只給了「位置關係」：across from the break room。
★ 陷阱：copier（Copy Room）被念了兩次，但那是「隔壁」不是「對面」。
★ 平面圖題的關鍵字就那幾個：across from（對面）、next to（隔壁）、between（中間）、at the end of（走廊底）。先把它們聽熟。

questions.q: What does the man say about the copier?
questions.note: the copier was finally repaired yesterday。

lines.t: I'm putting together the supply order for the new branch. Is there anything urgent?
Take a look at the inventory sheet. There's one product we're completely out of, and that has to go in today's order.
I see it. Everything else we still have at least a few of.
The lamps are getting low as well, but those can wait until next month.
Understood. I'll submit the urgent one now and flag the lamps for December.

questions.q: What is the man preparing?
questions.note: 第一句 the supply order for the new branch。

questions.q: Look at the graphic. Which product will the man order today?
questions.note:
圖表題。★ 正解的產品名整段沒被念出來 —— 線索是 completely out of（庫存 0）。
★ 陷阱：lamps 被明確念出來兩次，但女子說 those can wait，是「不急」的那一項。
★ 庫存表最常考的三種說法：out of stock（0）、running low（數量最小但非 0）、fully stocked（數量最大）。

questions.q: What will the man do about the desk lamps?
choices: Include them in a later order.
Ask for a discount on them.
questions.note: flag the lamps for December —— 選項用 a later order 改寫 December。

lines.t: Good afternoon, everyone, and welcome aboard the airport shuttle. We've just departed the conference center, so our next stop will be the final stop on this route. Please remain seated until the vehicle comes to a complete stop. One quick note for anyone attending tomorrow's trade show: the morning shuttle will run every fifteen minutes instead of every half hour, beginning at seven A.M. And if you left a bag in the overhead rack on an earlier trip, our lost and found desk is inside the main terminal and stays open until nine tonight.

questions.q: Look at the graphic. Where will the shuttle stop next?
questions.note:
圖表題。★ 正解的站名沒被念出來，線索是 the final stop on this route（路線圖最後一站）。
★ 雙陷阱：conference center 是「剛離開」的站，main terminal 是失物招領的位置 —— 兩個都被念出來了。
★ 路線圖題常用的位置詞：next stop、final/last stop、the stop before、two stops from here。

questions.q: What change will take place tomorrow morning?
questions.note: every fifteen minutes instead of every half hour —— 選項用 more frequently 概括，這是 Part 4 最典型的改寫。

questions.q: What does the speaker say about the lost and found desk?
choices: It is located in the main terminal.
It has moved to a new floor.
questions.note: 最後一句。Part 4 第三題多半落在獨白結尾。

lines.t: Thanks for joining this quarter's review. Before we turn to next year's targets, I want to spend a few minutes on the region that came in lowest this quarter. I want to be clear that this is not a staffing problem — that team is fully hired. What happened is that two of our largest accounts there postponed their orders until January, which pulled the whole figure down. I'd expect a strong rebound next quarter. The south region, by contrast, had its best three months on record, and I've asked their director to walk us through what worked. That will be right after the break.

questions.q: Look at the graphic. Which region will the speaker discuss first?
questions.note:
圖表題。★ 正解的地區名沒被念出來，線索是 came in lowest（長條圖最矮的一根）。
★ 陷阱：south region 被明確念出來，但那是「表現最好」的對照組，而且排在 after the break。
★ 長條圖題八成問這四種：highest、lowest、second highest、the one that increased/decreased。聽到最高級就立刻回圖上找。

questions.q: According to the speaker, what caused the decline?
questions.note: postponed their orders until January。★ 注意她特地否認了 staffing problem —— 那正是錯誤選項「員工離職」的來源。

questions.q: What will happen after the break?
choices: A director will give a presentation.
questions.note: I've asked their director to walk us through what worked。
